lessons: All checks passed and the production wiring largely works. The review snag is fixable: missing test coverage, a hot poll loop, and no way for the operator to find the hold id. Fix only these points and keep the current design.

test_control_cli.py: add a resume published under a live lock that writes no journal event. Add a stale-lifecycle case through the CLI: the request targets an earlier or ended lifecycle, is decided stale, and the hold stays. The current test only mismatches hold_id.

test_control_cli.py: add a release published before the pause that mints the hold, in the same or an earlier snapshot. Assert the later hold stays active. Drive these cases through main(), not a throwaway ControlInbox.

test_daemon_composition.py: drive main(['drain']) or a Drain built with the production _control_factory over a real journal. Assert that in-flight dispatch completes when a pause lands, and that control_decision accepted precedes control_hold in the journal.

test_daemon_composition.py: also assert dispatch stays blocked until the matching release and that a restart reuses the hold. Calling compose_daemon_control and DispatchPause directly does not prove routing.

_control_factory wait_for_control: replace the raw asyncio.sleep(0.01) with an injected clock or sleep seam at an operator-latency cadence of seconds. Each consume re-reads the whole journal, so 10 ms polling rescans it about 100 times a second.

Make the hold id reachable. Print the minted hold_id on a direct pause. For the live path, have _control read the journal and print the latest unreleased control_hold id. A resume that needs an id nobody shows is fail-stuck.

Live-lock publish: the latest control_lifecycle may belong to a dead process, or the lock may be held by run, triage or new. Journal the drain lifecycle together with its lock instance_id and publish only when LockHeld.holder matches. Otherwise refuse with a paved road.
Run `uv run pytest -q` to completion before claiming success. Prior attempts were killed with exit 143.
reason: Checks passed and the scope now fits one attempt; the review findings are concrete test-coverage and wiring fixes the findings steer, at the same capability.
